details.en: Shipped the planespotting [gallery](/gallery), with build-time photo compression and a [stats page](/spotting) built from its EXIF.

details.zh: 正在折腾接入 Home Assistant 的 ESP32 IoT 设备。

details.zh: 自托管了一套 Headscale 网络，用来从外面连回家里的服务器。相关折腾也写进了[博客](/blog)。

details.en: Planespotting whenever the weather and the schedule line up.
details.zh: 天气和时间都合适时，就出去拍飞机。
